text: Code reviews are an important step in software development. When developers check each other's code before it is added to the project, they can catch bugs early, when mistakes are easier and cheaper to fix. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from reading and discussing each other's work. This helps everyone understand the project better and improves communication. In addition, regular reviews lead to better team quality, since shared standards and helpful feedback raise the overall level of the code. For these reasons, code reviews should be a normal part of every development process.
